importantHonestyRule: V3 was designed while N250-to-N500 data was already partially observed, so that window is not a clean prospective test of V3. The first clean V3 evaluation begins only after the N500 checkpoint.

evaluation.anchor: Freeze the exact Hunter/Dynamic evidence snapshot at N500.
evaluation.extendedWindow: N500_TO_N1000 if the N750 result remains uncertain

brainGoal: Choose a trade only when estimated edge is positive, sufficiently supported, not dominated by model disagreement, and not contradicted by material regime drift. Otherwise abstain.
primaryMetrics: realized expectancyR of ABSTAINED candidates as a counterfactual cohort
ELIGIBLE minus Dynamic-V2 top-rank expectancy lift
coverage rate: fraction of candidates marked ELIGIBLE
90% lower confidence bound of selected expectancy when estimable
calibration between predicted truthScoreR and realized R

promotionGate.confidenceRequirement: 90% lower confidence bound above 0 when estimable
promotionGate.coverageRequirement: Must not create a fake edge by abstaining from almost everything; coverage must be reported and justified.
promotionGate.diversificationRequirement: Result must not depend mainly on one side, one timeframe, one score bucket, one spread bucket, or one short streak.
promotionGate.comparisonRequirement: Must beat the matched current Hunter ordering and frozen Dynamic Expected-R V2 on the same prospective candidate sets.

forbiddenUntilGatePasses: using V3 to place live orders
closing live incumbents to make room
retuning V3 thresholds from N500-to-N750 outcomes before the frozen evaluation ends
calling V3 omniscient, proven, or profitable without the prospective evidence
truthPrinciple: The brain is rewarded for being correct and for refusing unsupported bets, not for always producing an answer.
